pans.definition:
n cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel
n (Greek mythology) god of fields and woods and shepherds and flocks; represented as a man with goat's legs and horns and ears; identified with Roman Sylvanus or Faunus
n shallow container made of metal
n chimpanzees; more closely related to Australopithecus than to other pongids
v make a sweeping movement
v wash dirt in a pan to separate out the precious minerals
v express a totally negative opinion of

pansch's fissure.translation: [医] 潘奇氏裂(从中央沟下端到枕叶末端的裂)

pansexual.definition: n a person who participates in (or is open to) sexual activities of many kinds

pansexualism.translation: n. (认为人的所有思想和活动均与性本能有关的)泛性论

pansied.definition: a. Covered or adorned with pansies.

pansies.translation: n. 三色紫罗兰, <俚>脂粉气男子, 同性恋男子( pansy的名词复数 )

pansified.translation: a. (男子)脂粉气的,柔弱如女子的

pansinusitis.definition: n inflammation of all of the paranasal sinuses

pansophia.translation: [网络] 泛智体系；泛索菲亚；泛智主义

pansophical.definition:
a. All-wise; claiming universal knowledge; as,
   pansophical pretenders.

pansophy.definition:
n. Universal wisdom; esp., a system of universal knowledge
   proposed by Comenius (1592 -- 1671), a Moravian educator.
pansophy.translation: 博识, 万事皆知, 大智

panspermatism.translation: [医] 病原普遍存在说, 生原说, 生物发生说

panspermia.translation: n. [生]有生源说, 胚种论(亦作 panspermatism, panspermy)

panspermic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to panspermy; as, the panspermic
   hypothesis.

panspermy.definition:
n. The doctrine of the widespread distribution of germs,
   from which under favorable circumstances bacteria, vibrios, etc., may
   develop.
n. The doctrine that all organisms must come from living
   parents; biogenesis; -- the opposite of spontaneous generation.

pansporoblast.translation: 泛孢子母细胞, 泛成孢子细胞

pansy.definition: n. large-flowered garden plant derived chiefly from the wild pansy of Europe and having velvety petals of various colors
pansy.translation:
n. 圆三色堇
[化] 三色堇
